elements_not_encoded.reason: Hb has no observable/unit in the language; the urgent rule therefore fires less often than the page intends (anaemic jaundiced patients without another sign are missed).

judgment_calls.decision: Each 'X likely' rule uses the branch path (colour type + site or pattern); the descriptive boxes (red-brown, fine scale, present from birth, etc.) are not required.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Require descriptive features too (e.g. Scaly skin for tinea versicolor, Congenital for albinism); would fire less often and add check_for items.

judgment_calls.decision: Any hypopigmentation of skin gives probable tinea versicolor, as the page routes Light patches directly to that box.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Require scale, or restrict to trunk/neck/upper arms.

judgment_calls.decision: Red-box task and priority fire on clinical_finding Jaundice or active_condition Jaundice (the latter from the probable jaundice rule on yellow skin).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Only one of the two forms.

judgment_calls.decision: or of Shock (disorder) and systolic BP < 80; footnote 1 not imported.
